summary: Default /z-plan intent-compiler and adaptive INTENT execution model: /z-plan now compiles conversation through sharpen-first, optional user-approved brainstorm, iterative INTENT drafting, concern/audit gates, execution strategy metadata, and watcher checkpoint seams before /z-execute freezes INTENT for BFS execution with LEDGER checkpoints.

entry_points.summary: Validate frontmatter and required sections by intent level.
Set frozen_at back to pending for amended contracts.
Stamp frozen_at idempotently; reports FROZEN or ALREADY_FROZEN.
Create LEDGER.md frontmatter if absent without overwriting existing content.
Evaluate checklist criteria from INTENT, LEDGER citations, and cumulative diff.
/z-plan default path is conversation -> sharpened problem -> optional ideated framing -> intent contract -> execution DAG; full SDD is explicit compatibility only.
/z-plan must run shared /z-sharpen inline or consume fresh GRILL.md before planning.
/z-plan asks whether to run /z-brainstorm and may recommend it when alternatives remain; it never auto-dispatches brainstorm.
After sharpen and optional brainstorm artifacts stabilize, /z-plan evaluates the shared compaction/checkpoint seam before high-context planning.
/z-plan restates the sharpened problem/framing, grounds only missing source facts, drafts INTENT.md, and iterates with the user 1-2 times.

entry_points.summary: Before final read-through, /z-plan surfaces LLM concern/decision/assumption flags and asks whether to fold in /z-audit-plan.
/z-plan generates TASKS.md plus task-to-intent mapping, safe parallel batches, serial blockers, review gates, checkpoint cadence, and workstream/handoff metadata.
After execution strategy and handoff artifacts stabilize, /z-plan evaluates the shared checkpoint seam before /z-execute.
SPEC.md present -> legacy; INTENT.md present -> intent; neither -> halt.

Generate BFS levels from frozen INTENT, LEDGER, unmet criteria, and prior outcomes.
Marks TASKS.md stale so task-tree-generator regenerates after amended contract.

invariants: /z-plan default mode is an intent compiler; legacy full SDD is explicit compatibility only.
Sharpening is the first planning phase: /z-plan runs the shared /z-sharpen inline contract or consumes fresh GRILL.md before INTENT drafting.
Brainstorm is a user ask gate: /z-plan may recommend /z-brainstorm but never auto-dispatches it.
INTENT.md is drafted through a short user iteration loop before final approval.
Concern flags are surfaced before final read-through, and /z-plan asks whether to incorporate an optional /z-audit-plan scan.
Execution strategy metadata includes task-to-intent mapping, safe parallel batches, serial blockers, review gates, checkpoint cadence, and workstream/handoff data.
task-tree-generator may emit wider same-level INTENT BFS batches only when siblings have precise disjoint file scope and executor fan-out can be capped or partitioned.
Watcher checkpoint seams run after preplanning artifacts and after execution strategy/handoff artifacts stabilize.
Unknown acceptance state counts as unmet.
workflow.intent_parallel_levels defaults true but controls within-level sibling dispatch only, under /z-execute safety preconditions.
gotchas: workflow.intent_bfs_level_cap is runtime-read and may not appear in DEFAULTS; empty/None falls back to 6.
stale_reason: amended-intent must replace any existing key, not duplicate it.
Brainstorm and audit are ask gates, not automatic route changes: /z-plan can recommend /z-brainstorm or /z-audit-plan, but it never launches them.
Execution strategy metadata is part of the planning contract consumed by fresh /z-execute context; do not treat TASKS.md alone as the complete handoff.
Do not pass spec_path/plan_path to implementers in INTENT mode.
Missing, unparseable, overlapping, or scope_unknown same-level task scope serializes the affected INTENT BFS level/task; do not infer arbitrary fan-out.
Default-on workflow.intent_parallel_levels still requires precise Files scope, bounded/partitioned fan-out, and per-task review diff isolation or serialized review capture.

config_keys.workflow.planning_mode: intent|full recommendation for the explicit mode gate
config_keys.workflow.intent_level: auto|quick|standard|deep; level flags override and bypass classifier
config_keys.workflow.intent_parallel_levels: bool, default true; opt out with false; same-level INTENT BFS only when /z-execute safety preconditions pass
config_keys.workflow.hermes_enabled: bool master gate for Hermes machinery

memories.text: When INTENT acceptance promises DAG/workstream metadata, generator failure must halt or surface clearly; prose fallback/||true silently erases the execution contract.
In adaptive INTENT BFS, later task-tree generation must receive concern flags, brainstorm choice, execution strategy, and task-to-intent/workstream context before tasks are drafted.

For adaptive INTENT execution, aggregate review is a computed gate: log required/not-required from realized task count, workstreams, high-risk flags, and cross-workstream criteria; do not replace it with unconditional final review.

Load-bearing intent-conversation artifacts must be resolved through stable plan-root pointers or exact handoff references, never by scanning archives for the latest matching flags or brainstorm choice.

The brainstorm ask gate needs a durable route/choice artifact with skipped, existing, and routed states, and later /z-plan resumes must consume that artifact deterministically before drafting INTENT.md.
